title: ION Trade Commitment Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 mirror of the TradeCommitment v1 OpenAPI schema pack. Core commitment identity, resources, offers, and quantities remain on the Beckn Commitment object.

IONTradeCommitment.title: IONTradeCommitment
IONTradeCommitment.description: Trade-specific attributes of a Beckn Commitment. Core Commitment fields identify the commitment, resources, quantities, and offer; this extension carries only the line-specific commercial and buyer-selection details that are not represented by the core object.

price.description: Committed post-discount price for this commitment.

originalPrice.description: Pre-discount price for display and audit. Omit when it is equal to price and no discount applies.

addOnIds.description: Identifiers of offer add-ons selected for this commitment. Add-ons are defined by the selected Offer; this field records the buyer's selection.

selectedCustomizations.description: Customization options selected for this commitment. The combination of groupId and optionId must identify each selection without ambiguity; label is display-only.

optionId.description: Identifier of the selected option within the group.

label.description: Human-readable display label for the selection.

specialInstructions.description: Buyer instructions that apply specifically to this commitment.

replacementPreferred.description: Whether the buyer prefers replacement over refund for this committed line if the supplied resource is defective, incorrect, or otherwise eligible for remediation. This is line-specific because different commitments in the same contract may require different remedies.
